core_obligations: Set up the forgetful functor (proof lines 8872-8880): the author denotes by F the forgetful functor from R-G-modules to G-modules and identifies the two cohomology functors along it.

Compare the cohomology (proof lines 8880-8895): using an injective resolution in the category of R-G-modules, whose underlying modules are injective for the action of G by the companion result, the author shows that the cohomology computed in either category agrees.
Conclude the commutativity of the diagram (proof lines 8895-8903): hence for every i the two ways around the diagram agree, which is the statement.
proof_roadmap: Introduce the forgetful functor and identify the two cohomology functors along it.
Use injective resolutions and the companion comparison of injectives.
Read off the commutativity of the diagram in every degree.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the diagram comparing the group cohomology of R-G-modules with that of their underlying G-modules commutes in every degree (statement lines 8857-8870, with the Xy-pic diagram delivered verbatim). The proof introduces the forgetful functor and compares the two cohomology functors through injective resolutions, using the companion result that an injective R-G-module is injective as a G-module (proof lines 8872-8903). The non-formal content is the comparison of the resolutions in the two categories. The claim is H2: one reduction to resolutions plus one companion input.
